description: Angular component for a dialog that displays resources in use, with functionalities to show references, delete resources, and toggle previews.

classes.name: ResourcesInUseDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing a resources-in-use dialog, including display, delete, and toggle references functionalities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting configuration, displayPreview, dataSource, and references based on input data.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning any data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Closes the dialog and returns selected resources for deletion.

methods.name: toggleShowReferences
methods.description: Toggles the display of resource references in a popover, adding or removing button classes accordingly.
